title: THE OFFER LINE AND THE BOSS BAR REACH THE SCREEN
why: Found by the trade audit of 2026-10-03: the standing "NAME offers you ITEM, T or Y to take it" line and THE OVERSEER health bar were painted at the top of the HUD frame, before the clear that starts every HUD frame, so neither ever reached the screen; only the three second toast did, which is a large part of why trading was unclear. Both are drawn after the clear now.
now: A trade offer now stays on screen with its countdown until it is taken, and THE OVERSEER shows its health bar.
